subject: Leave OpenAI's Sign in with ChatGPT route untouched until qualified
diff_check: clean change.diff is the commit diff (git diff parent commit -- paths); the seeded change.diff replaces both added lines of the route check (src routes.ts and dist routes.js) and applies with patch -p1 to an archive of the parent, reproducing the seeded tree (checked)
class_note: Requested class was security (credential reaching a non-qualified host). Not shown: isChatGPTSignIn only decides whether Freeflow rewrites or replays a payload; Pi sends the credential to the same base URL either way. Built as logic on the same check, at the lead's instruction.

clean.description: The change as committed. No defect is planted.

seeded.description: The OAuth check of the Sign in with ChatGPT route is inverted to undefined-as-true: `=== true` becomes `!== false`. A host whose model registry lacks the OAuth check (so the call yields undefined) is then treated as Sign in with ChatGPT, and its requests skip Freeflow's adaptations. The commit's rule is that only an OAuth answer qualifies a route; API-key and Codex routes are unchanged. The dist file is mirrored so the committed tests, which import dist, exercise the seed.
seeded.rule_quoted: requirements.md item 5: "Only an OAuth answer from the host's model registry qualifies a route. A host that does not provide the registry's OAuth check, or whose check fails, leaves the route unqualified."

proof.method: logic: the committed tests pass on clean and fail on seeded
proof.seeded_result: 17 tests, 15 pass, 2 fail: "any provider that declares a lifetime and cache prices is warmed through its own output cap" (cache-keepalive, test 8) and "the sign-in route is the openai Responses API at api.openai.com with a ChatGPT credential" (chatgpt-sign-in, test 15)
proof.seed_applied_to: pi-extension/src/provider-support/routes.ts (compiles: tsc -p pi-extension/tsconfig.json exit 0) and pi-extension/dist/provider-support/routes.js (the file the tests import)
